title: Path Covering Spaces of Posets
summary: In this paper we extend results concerning a kind of covering space for finite posets that bears some analogy to the topological theory of covering spaces. Previous work focused on ranked, locally-finite posets with a unique minimal element. In this previous work the notion of a covering space based on preservation of path weights was defined, and it was shown that, given a poset, there is a unique universal covering space which has an explicit description.
